warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
tactics: Use a static visual aid for routes, a remembered object or a plan, or a sound to support a plausible distraction. It does not reveal information the caster never had.
An image is not a physical barrier and ordinary Minor Illusion cannot impose conditions or manufacture real equipment.
Minor Illusion is not physical cover and cannot activate the 2024 Illusory Reality feature: that feature requires an eligible Illusion cast with a spell slot, not this cantrip.
